derivation: from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and G5590 (ψυχή);
def: to be in good spirits, i.e. feel encouraged

occurrences.text: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
